newsitem.title: GERMANY: German manufacturing order shows improvement - Buba.
newsitem.headline: German manufacturing order shows improvement - Buba.

text.p: The German economy showed signs of recovery as both manufacturing orders and productivity were higher in the first two months on 1997 than the previous two months, the Bundesbank said in its April report.
Orders in the manufacturing sector in January and February were about one percent above the average rate of the fourth quarter 1996, the Bundesbank said.
Foreign orders were again the engine behind growth with domestic order remaining more or less subdued, the central bank said.

Productivity in the manufacturing sector in January and February was also considerably stronger, topping the average output of the fourth quarter 1996 by 2.5 percent. But the Bundesbank also said that it could not be ruled out that some of this activity was triggered by a certain amount of catching up.
